commands.stdout:
usage: macos_window_evidence.py [-h] --app APP --output OUTPUT [--launch]
                                [--window-id WINDOW_ID] --configuration
                                {Debug,Release} [--note NOTE]
                                [--wait-seconds WAIT_SECONDS]

Launch an isolated macOS app and capture its actual visible window. Uses
LaunchServices and screencapture; never injects gameplay or captures the whole
desktop as a fallback. Requires macOS desktop Screen Recording access.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --app APP
  --output OUTPUT       New PNG file; existing output/evidence is never
                        overwritten
  --launch              Open the app normally if it is not already running
  --window-id WINDOW_ID
                        Select one of this exact app's windows when several
                        exist
  --configuration {Debug,Release}
                        Actual build configuration, supplied by the examiner
  --note NOTE           Examiner's scene/settings description, not inferred
                        verification
  --wait-seconds WAIT_SECONDS

limitations: Static routing review, no model A/B evaluation
No game runtime changes or new gameplay PASS
Host skill discovery not yet observed in a new session
